description: The unchanged first 11-signal DDR byte from the real H3 CPU-to-RAM board. All 479 source pads, 22 endpoints, two native layers and source 0.0889 mm clearance are preserved. Original copper was removed. There is no source-authored length-matching limit.
routingBoundary: The worker evaluates a seed Circuit solely to enter its normal bus_lanes phase. At Core's synchronous solver:started construction boundary, the seed SRJ is replaced by this exact original input before the native solver is instantiated. This tests the engine actually shipped in the worker; it does not repeat CAD import or claim a complete board.
